review_notes: I read the whole 88-line file and checked the `pointField_unique` and `canonicalGraphWordPath_ae` API in FieldTowerRepresentative.lean and FieldTowerCanonicalGraph.lean. The file has parallel pairs: `correctionTower_pointField` and `pressureTower_pointField`, and `graphCorrectionWordPath_ae` and `graphPressureWordPath_ae`. Each pair is a one- or two-line wrapper around an existing lemma, applied to a different tower and a different continuity or ae fact. A shared lemma would save almost no proof text and would need abstraction over the tower and the point field. `graphCorrectionWordPath_hasDerivAt` and `graphCorrectionWordPath_initial` are each used once, so nothing repeats there. I found no nontrivial reasoning repeated across proofs that meets the rubric. The only remaining uncertainty is whether the other files in the project repeat these patterns. I did not review them.
